status: backported from the independently tested v1.4.1 classification branch
principles: classification is downstream of candidate preservation
raw NIST candidates, ranks and scores are never deleted or changed
exact-name or CAS invariants are applied after all optional evidence layers
AI/model review may select a candidate but cannot override a locked final classification
C/H-only and non-N aromatic hydrocarbons cannot be assigned to the protein/microbial group
source labels are operational marker groups, not confirmed source apportionment

priority_rules.match: Toluene, toluene, Methylbenzene, Benzene, methyl-, or CAS 108-88-3/108883
priority_rules.warning: Operational group only: toluene is multi-origin and may also arise from charred material, proteins, petrogenic inputs, or secondary pyrolysis; it is not a unique lignin or fulvic-acid tracer.

application_specific_note.Lake_Biwa_Figure_4: The Lake Biwa double-shot experiment used toluene as the solvent of the added internal-standard solution; it must not be interpreted as an environmental source marker. Figure 4 is an archived structural-product aggregate. The origin-category correction P to L leaves the structural product class 'Aromatic hydrocarbons' unchanged. Component-level rows underlying the archived aggregate are not deposited, so the figure is not numerically reconstructed from a different data version.
